parole.testo: From Hiligaynon iraya (“inland; upstream”), referring to the inland and mountainous regions Karay-a speakers inhabit, in contrast to the coastal regions Hiligaynon speakers inhabit.

parole.significato: a person who climbs coconut palm trees and gathers coconuts to collect tuba (toddy palm wine)
parole.testo: From possibly Hiligaynon mananggit, from man- + sanggit (“to seize; to snatch; to take hold of”). See also Cebuano manananggot, Cebuano sanggot (“sickle”), Cebuano kawit.
